keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «알에서 아기 공룡이 나온다(놀라운 일)» 와 «알 덕분에 동네에서 가장 큰 친구가 생겼다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the surprise (a baby dinosaur comes out of the egg) and the ending (Jay gets the biggest friend in town). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The dinosaur grows so big that its head hits the ceiling.
Jay takes it to the big dinosaur park and visits it every Sunday.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why does Jay take the dinosaur to the park?
opts: It grows too big for his house.
It wants to find its mom.
evs: Soon its head hits the ceiling!
It eats all of Jay's broccoli.
Jay finds a big spotted egg in the woods.
Now he visits his dino friend every Sunday.
why: «Soon its head hits the ceiling!» 공룡이 너무 커져서 머리가 천장에 닿아요. 집이 너무 작아진 거예요.
Its head hits the ceiling. The dinosaur is too big for the house.

qs.q: "That night, the egg goes crack, crack!" What does "crack" mean here?
qs.qko: «the egg goes crack, crack!» 에서 «crack» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: He takes it home and keeps it warm.
Every day, it grows bigger and bigger.
Jay takes it to the big dinosaur park.
why: «A baby dinosaur comes out!» 바로 다음에 아기 공룡이 나와요. 그러니 «crack» 은 알이 쩍 갈라지는 소리예요.
Right after the crack, a baby dinosaur comes out. So the egg breaks open.

qs.q: Where and when does Jay see his dino friend now?
qs.qko: 제이는 이제 언제, 어디에서 공룡 친구를 만나나요?
opts: at the big dinosaur park every Sunday
evs: Jay takes it to the big dinosaur park.
Now he visits his dino friend every Sunday.
That night, the egg goes crack, crack!
It eats all of Jay's broccoli.
why: 공룡은 공룡 공원에 있고(«Jay takes it to the big dinosaur park.»), 제이는 일요일마다 만나러 가요(«Now he visits his dino friend every Sunday.»). 두 문장을 이어야 «어디»와 «언제»를 모두 알 수 있어요.
The dinosaur is at the park, and Jay visits it every Sunday. You need both sentences.

ends: The dinosaur comes to Jay’s birthday party at the park.
공룡이 공원에서 열린 제이의 생일 파티에 온다.
Jay finds another egg in the woods.
제이가 숲에서 알을 하나 더 찾는다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Jay is a good friend</u> because <u>he visits the dinosaur every Sunday</u>.”

img.cover: At night in a cozy bedroom, a boy with short curly black hair in a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts kneels by a soft blanket with wide happy eyes as a big spotted egg cracks open, and a friendly green dinosaur with orange spots on its back and a round nose, still a tiny baby, pokes its head out of the shell.

scenes.1: In a living room with an empty broccoli bowl tipped over on the floor, a friendly green dinosaur with orange spots on its back and a round nose, now very tall, bumps its head on the ceiling and blinks in surprise, while a boy with short curly black hair in a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts covers his mouth and laughs.
scenes.2: In a big sunny dinosaur park with tall trees and a blue pond, a boy with short curly black hair in a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts hugs the leg of a friendly green dinosaur with orange spots on its back and a round nose, now huge, and the dinosaur bends its long neck down to smile at him.
